about: Texture sources for the vehicle bakes (build_vehicles.py via vehicle_texprep.py). Generated by the lead with Codex image_generation (Kiran's account, approved 2026-10-01), one image per call, ~1254 px PNG. Raw PNGs stay out of the repo; only the baked vehicle WebPs ship.
template: Use your image generation tool to create ONE square, seamlessly tileable, photorealistic texture: {description}. Flat even lighting (no shadows, no highlights, no perspective, top-down orthographic like a PBR albedo scan), no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no insignia, no markings.

sources.olive_paint_albedo: worn olive-drab military paint on steel (the lead's first sample)
sources.paint_darkgrey_albedo: worn dark gunmetal-grey military paint on aluminium aircraft skin panels, chipped edges, faded patches, oil and exhaust stains, fine scratches
sources.rust_heavy_albedo: heavy rust on corroded steel plate, flaking rust scale, pitting, orange and dark brown oxide over bare grey metal
sources.burnt_metal_albedo: fire-damaged burnt steel, black soot, blue-purple heat discoloration, blistered remnants of olive paint, ash dust
sources.tyre_tread_albedo: worn off-road military truck tyre tread rubber surface seen straight on, deep chunky lugs, dried mud in the grooves, dust
sources.tyre_sidewall_albedo: plain black rubber tyre sidewall surface, matte, slightly cracked and scuffed, dust, completely blank with no lettering at all
sources.canvas_tarp_albedo: weathered olive military canvas tarpaulin fabric, coarse weave, dust, water stains, faded areas
sources.bed_plating_albedo: scuffed steel diamond-plate floor painted olive, paint worn off on the raised diamonds showing bare metal, dirt and grit in the grooves
sources.cast_armor_albedo: rough cast armour steel with weld seams, pitted surface, worn dark olive paint, rust in the pits
sources.mud_dust_albedo: dried mud and dust splatter layer on dark metal, cracked dried mud patches, light dust film, splash marks
sources.scorched_ground_albedo: scorched concrete paving after an explosion, black soot, burnt debris fragments, small cracks, ash

unused: tyre_tread (the tread is modelled and baked from geometry)
